summary: g4kit.py derive dropped a geometric default (a gap or margin of the calorimeter, endcap_disks, shell_veto, tof or trd kit) that the design geometry file gave, and built the detector-spec with the kit's own default, without a message; its geometry-derivation record still hashed the design file as if the value had been used.

observables: the dimensions of detector-spec/1 files that g4kit.py derived: bar, tower, straw and readout pitches, plane and module widths, guide sizes, disk margins, the world size, and every placement that depends on them
the geometry_id of such specifications and of the computational-runs, study specs and design candidates bound to them
impact.bias: each affected dimension took the kit's default in place of the design's value: for the tof kit with eight 100 mm bars and a design gap of 0 mm, a bar pitch of 100.5 mm instead of 100.0 mm, a plane 804 mm wide instead of 800 mm and a world of 7896 mm instead of 7880 mm; a design that gave the kit's own default value is unaffected
impact.trigger: a design-geometry/1 file whose fields name one of the kit's geometric_defaults (bar_gap_mm, tower_gap_mm, wrap_mm, guide_mm, guide_side_mm, guide_gap_mm, disk_margin_mm, readout_gap_mm, straw_gap_mm) with a value other than the kit's default; the shipped mappings (contracts/rules/design_geometry/*.json) map kit inputs only, so only a hand-written or edited design geometry file triggers it

applies_to.match_basis: a design candidate bound to a g4kit.py derivation names its geometry-derivation/1 record in extension.geometry_derivation_ref; it is affected only when its design geometry file names a geometric default (check the file's fields)

outputs.how_to_recognize: a detector-spec/1 file and a geometry-derivation/1 record (kit name calorimeter, endcap_disks, shell_veto, tof or trd) written by g4kit.py derive from a design-geometry/1 file whose fields name one of that kit's geometric_defaults

remedy: rerun g4kit.py derive on the design geometry file with this version and use the new detector-spec; rerun the computational-runs and studies made from the old specification (its geometry_id changes), and redo design evaluations whose candidates bind it
